note: v2819: REG-761 THE SHELF stacks two flow strips styled to read as one engine while drawing from different modules with different vocabularies - the river lanes from reel_router with 4 lanes over 9 stations, the printer spine from printer.stream with 7 stations - and both say PRINTER meaning different things. Neither named its source, though the freshness convention already existed in the same file with 3 hits and none in the shelf code. Each now names its engine. The law is the JOIN not the string: the first cut BUILT the tag and never rendered it, which is the same as no label, so the gate asserts it is USED and that is one of the two red-proofs.
